中文名: 豪梅·克拉雷特·穆克萨尔德
出生地: 西班牙,圣库加特-德尔巴列斯
简介: Jaume Claret Muxart is a Catalonian filmmaker. His works include the short films HER AND I (2020), which was screened in San Sebastián and Rotterdam, and DIE DONAU (2022), which was shown at FIDMarseille and Valladolid International Film Festival. He teaches design and production at institutions including the Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya and is a member of the artist collective Arquitectura Filmada.
